title: BulkAssignMonitoringWorkflowRequest
description: Request to assign multiple monitoring workflows

workflowIds.description: List of monitoring workflow IDs to assign. Either workflowIds or filter must be provided.

assignTo.description: List of user IDs to assign workflows to. Workflows will be evenly distributed across these users

filter.description: Filter criteria as JSON string (URL encoded). Used to fetch workflow IDs when workflowIds is not provided. See GET /monitoring-workflows endpoint documentation for filter format.
